title: Emerald Processor Blueprint
author: Hundin Indani Glodkeit
pages: The Emerald Processor makes and breaks a bank. With it, we have our source of power, we can turn emerald from a useless ore into any object or into a fighter. Without it, we decay.

Thus, this book contains the recipe on how to construct another Emerald Processor in the event that your bank loses it. While this book is useless without a bank processor, please do not let this book leave your bank.
Note: This recipe only works in a bank’s emerald crafting grid.
